parent_result.identity: POST-REGISTERED v0.8N-E1 REPAIRED HELD-OUT EVALUATION OF SEALED PHASE-B CHECKPOINTS

input_requirements.raw_predictions: the complete v0.8O 36-cell prediction matrix, hash-tree sealed before this analysis starts

neighborhood_vector.implementation: call the unchanged frozen neighborhood_metrics function from analyze_phase_b_v01.py; do not alter metric definitions
neighborhood_vector.aggregation: arithmetic means by seed, arm, epoch, and family; retain all four families and all 36 cells; no composite score

transition_decomposition.report: counts and proportions per seed, arm, epoch, overall and separately by each of the four held-out families
transition_decomposition.partition_invariant: the four cell counts sum to 2000 for every seed/arm/epoch and to 500 within each family

paired_trajectory_contrasts.primary_display: SHAM minus MATCHED for every seed and epoch, on each named metric separately
paired_trajectory_contrasts.neighborhood_pairing: join exact neighborhood_id within each seed, epoch, and arm; report mean paired difference overall and by family
paired_trajectory_contrasts.dupe_and_sham_context: also retain all DUP/MATCHED/SHAM trajectories; do not rank arms globally
paired_trajectory_contrasts.uncertainty: descriptive only; no pooled optimizer-seed inference, no endpoint equivalence claim, no outcome-dependent subgrouping

parameter_trajectory.source: sealed initial head templates and all sealed epoch checkpoint state_dict values
parameter_trajectory.global_displacement: sqrt(sum over every parameter tensor of float64 squared difference from the paired seed initialization)
parameter_trajectory.per_tensor_displacement: same L2 calculation for each exact state_dict key, with parameter count
parameter_trajectory.arm_update_cosines: cosine between concatenated parameter update vectors for each of the three arm pairs within a seed and epoch; epoch 0 undefined/null
parameter_trajectory.limits: descriptive parameter-space distances only; no basin, mechanism, or causal interpretation

trajectory_labels.assignment_rule: do not assign labels by an automatic threshold; discuss only as explicit descriptive patterns supported by the sealed trajectories

interpretation_ceiling: descriptive mapping of already-existing optimizer trajectories on the E1 held-out object; no checkpoint is promoted, and epoch-specific behavior only motivates future prospective tests
